description: Fabro per-stage auto-commit swept the 'gofib' binary (2.6MB build artifact from qualitygate's 'go build') into git in the tester commit. Implementer's 'build artifact removed' step is undone by the gate regenerating it before commit.
resolution: Root .gitignore now ignores 'gofib'; binary untracked from the index. Future stages leave clean trees.
